wiki.title: Rodney Hall (Mississippi politician)
wiki.extract: Rodney Hall (born December 7, 1987) is an American politician serving as a member of the Mississippi House of Representatives for the 20th District. A member of the Republican Party, he previously served on Capitol Hill as a congressional staffer for Mississippi’s 1st Congressional Distrtct. Hall assumed office in January 2024 and is notably the first African-American Republican to serve in the Mississippi House since the Reconstruction era.
